loop: save evidence and queue next experiment
continuation: Reports are checkpoints, not a stopping rule. New evidence changes priorities; an unchanged result is not a reason to rerun the same experiment.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Text-grounded partial constraints can veto poisoned reference feedback before it harms an initially text-consistent model.
next_experiments.trigger: T19 found exact conflicts in four public references; T17 evidence harmed two correct answers.
next_experiments.experiment: Freeze a reference-independent source-claim extraction extension on training data. Compare reference-only feedback, source-veto feedback and no-update on the same proposed models and question budget. Keep official correctness as the original endpoint, and report text-claim violations as a separate endpoint with exact spans and witnesses.
next_experiments.first_action: Read all T19 covered claims including the unflagged time-capacity example; distinguish overly permissive from overly restrictive references. Register T21 before extending the grammar.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Gains under accurate reference confirmation persist on independently sourced problems with matched information and budgets.
next_experiments.experiment: Freeze method and primary comparator; register new problem sources and cluster-aware sampling; specify label adjudication separately from model predictions, confirmation reliability conditions, repeated generation and model robustness. Produce the protocol first; paid runs use the existing cumulative ledger.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Explicitly distinguishing share-of-invested-total from share-of-available-budget explains recurring investment failures and yields informative clarification questions.
next_experiments.experiment: Form both mathematically valid denominator interpretations from original text, find separating plans with exact arithmetic, and test query selection against a direct reread baseline. Keep ambiguity labels separate from original gold.

next_experiments.hypothesis: A source-anchored ratio compiler generates useful repairs beyond copying A/B constraint rows.
next_experiments.experiment: Generate ratio and direction alternatives from quoted sentences and variable bindings, add them to the fixed local candidate bank, and compare matched-budget fresh checks and max-split checks. Develop on train, freeze before dev analysis, report historical test reuse explicitly.
